title: Rav Chanilai Mechozna’i

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Eruvin 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.57a.9), raising an objection to Rav Ashi.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara gives Rav Chanilai Mechozna’ah’s objection to Rav Ashi about the dimensions of a squared city. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1545&lang=en) cites the same exchange and tentatively compares the name with Rav Chanin of Mechoza.
